items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “We’re [Jane and?] [inaudible].” And, “You gotta come out to Montauk.” ... So we went there one night, one weekend.

ctx.x: On the eighth floor. Like here. And they said, “Hey.” And finally we went, “Yeah, I’m Toots [inaudible].” “We’re [Jane and?] [inaudible].” And, “You gotta come out to Montauk.” I said, “You guys are so happy when you come back on Sundays,” and so… “Oh, we have a house in Montauk now.” I’m going [inaudible]. “We have a good time.” [laughs] So we went there one night, one weekend. Labor Day or a typical weekend, there was [inaudible]. And we look through. They were on a hill, you know. And we look. “What’s that…
